description: Use this when accuracy matters more than speed, or when the user questions whether a holiday date is right: contracts, payroll, settlement, compliance deadlines. Compares the national holiday list for a country and year across three independent providers and reports exactly where they agree and disagree, rather than picking one.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example AU, US, GB.

name: cross_check_holidays
title: Cross-check holidays across independent sources
